definitions.explanation: Taking care of someone or helping with their needs.
Used in polite expressions to acknowledge help received.

examples.japanese: いつもお{世話|せわ}になっています。
examples.english: Thank you for always taking care of me.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}の{世話|せわ}をする。
お{世話|せわ}になりました。
{猫|ねこ}の{世話|せわ}は{毎日|まいにち}{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: Taking care of a cat is a lot of work every day.

examples.japanese: {入院|にゅういん}していたとき、{看護師|かんごし}さんにお{世話|せわ}になった。
examples.english: The nurses took care of me when I was in the hospital.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{祖父|そふ}の{世話|せわ}をしながら、{仕事|しごと}も{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: My mother continues working while also taking care of my grandfather.

notes:
お{世話|せわ} is the polite form; {世話|せわ} alone is neutral.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・お{世話|せわ}になる (receive someone's care/help)
・お{世話|せわ}になっております (business greeting: 'Thank you for your continued support')
・お{世話|せわ}になりました (Thank you for everything)
・{世話|せわ}をする/をやく (to take care of, to look after)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{世話|せわ}が{焼|や}ける (to be troublesome to deal with)
・{世話|せわ}がない (be no trouble)
